latHint: Think the device in your pocket that buzzes with messages.
pivHint: A RING is the round arena where circus acts perform. As a verb, to give someone a RING means to ______ them.
winText: Calling it right. RING was the pivot - a circus arena to a quick call: to RING someone is to PHONE them.
lossText: PHONE - to call someone on a handset. RING was the pivot: a RING is a circus arena, but to give someone a RING means to PHONE them.
